P3F.25.statement: \par\noindent\textbf{Physical-line correction, 17 November 2026.} The old signed nonzero physical return is refuted. Its computed index is the dual-line index \(A_U\); the actual sphere class is \(-A_U\). In particular the degree-four weighted OS47 example has class \(4\). The zero-reference conclusions and the source, page and cap maps are retained. K68--69 give the corrected physical transfer. The following earlier assertion and its argument are retained as the located historical claim; their corrected current consequences are proved in K68--69.\medskip\par The actual real trace gives $A=(12s_\delta-p_{\rm rel})/24=-R\cdot O$, with both mapping-torus and bordism boundary reversals included. The original and coprime higher reference-fan returns are zero. For the Viaclovsky and Liu--Rollenske source data, the positive loop of the explicit cover $\lambda=r^4$ has reference-fan return zero; P3K.35 also constructs the closed cover $\lambda=w^2$. In the Liu--Rollenske notation $u=\lambda$, P3K.36 proves that one $u$-loop has no biholomorphic endpoint identification. The positive weighted OS47 loop has $A=-4$, oriented class $24\pmod{28}$, and a mapping torus not diffeomorphic to the product.

P3K.6.statement: \par\noindent\textbf{Physical-line correction, 17 November 2026.} The meridian-one Thom line is the Hermitian dual of the physical line. Its page restriction is \(-c_1(M)\). The embedded trace, collars and integer uniqueness are retained; the positive page-line assertion is refuted by the explicit dual arrow in K68. The following earlier assertion and its argument are retained as the located historical claim; their corrected current consequences are proved in K68--69.\medskip\par Let one positive gamma turn denote the actual parameter cover whose angular clutch is P3F.13. The orbit family of this cover is the product \(Y\times S^1_\theta\), with \(Y=S^5\), and its fixed trace is \[ T_F=\{(R_\theta(p),\theta):p\in F\}, \] where \(R_\theta\) is the gamma rotation on the cusp orbit product of P3F.9. Use its product trivialization preserving the Seifert gamma coordinate. In these coordinates \(R_\theta\) is pure gamma rotation, including the explicitly trivialized source-translation suspension. There is a compact properly embedded oriented four-manifold \(X\subset Z=Y\times D^2\), with boundary \(T_F\), assembled from the actual page \(V\) and a product compression trace. Its complement has a unique integral class \(x\) with meridian value one. On the outer boundary this class is the actual delta-circle Euler class. On the graph copy of \(V\), its restriction to the framed normal section is exactly \(c_1(M)\).
P3K.6.agrees_with_stated_value: S6_02_PUSH C.3.10: agrees; S6_02_PUSH C.3.21: agrees; S6_04 B.6.10: undetermined

P3K.10.statement: \par\noindent\textbf{Physical-line correction, 17 November 2026.} The displayed physical class \(25\) is refuted. The same positive primitive OS45 family has physical integer \(3\), Eells--Kuiper invariant \(3/28\), and class \(3\). Its source, line, cap and topology proof is retained. K68--69 prove the missing dual-line and sphere-gluing arrow. The following earlier assertion and its argument are retained as the located historical claim; their corrected current consequences are proved in K68--69.\medskip\par Let \(S\) be the minimal regular elliptic surface with section \(O\) whose affine equation is \[ y^2=x^3-3f(t)x+2g(t),\qquad f=(t^2+1)^2+t,\qquad g=(t^2+1)^3+\frac32t(t^2+1)+\frac38. \] Put \(G=(t^2+1,\sqrt3/2)\), \(R=8G\), \(M=\mathcal O_S(R-O)\), and \(Q=G\). Choose any one of the four nodal fibres as the simple zero of the linearization. At the ordinary fibre \(t=0\), perform the multiplicity-one logarithmic gluing whose integral circle clutch is \(\widehat\gamma\). The resulting construction of Engel's Remark 8.5 gives a proper holomorphic family of compact complex manifolds diffeomorphic to the standard \(S^6\), over a punctured scalar disc \(0<|\lambda|<c\). For the positive \(\lambda\)-loop, with the complex orientation and the Eells--Kuiper convention of P3F.22, the return satisfies \[ A=-3,\qquad \mu(\Sigma_\Phi)=-\frac3{28},\qquad [\Phi]=25\in\mathbf Z/28. \] In particular this is a generator. The positive finite parameter pullbacks of this same family realize every oriented class in \(\Theta_7\). For every nonzero such class the mapping torus is not diffeomorphic to \(S^1\times S^6\).

P3K.17.statement: \par\noindent\textbf{Audit correction, 17 November 2026.} The asserted two-fan equality is false. P3K.65 constructs the full negative-to-positive native Cox comparison and gives classes -3k and 0 for the positive r-loop, and -k and 0 for the actual shorter w-loop. At k=1 the original negative fan has classes 25 and 27, respectively. The omitted second outer map has positive-normal determinant winding -2m; the first outer map is the identity. The local charged-cap construction is retained with its full outer marking. The earlier statement and argument below are preserved as the located prior claim. \medskip The negative- and positive-diagonal OS49 families have equal actual return index for every cap order \(m=3k\), \(k>0\), every signed primitive twist \(n=\pm1\), and every additional integral delta twist \(d\delta\). Their index is zero, their oriented return class is zero, and their actual mapping tori are products as in P3F.24. The comparison is an oriented bordism carrying the actual Euler line; it imposes no spin hypothesis on the comparison bordism. The endpoint index structures are the prescribed ones from the original families.

P3K.22.statement: \par\noindent\textbf{Physical-line correction, 17 November 2026.} The physical classes in the old reference table are refuted except for the self-opposite residue \(14\). In its four profile groups the actual physical integers are \(3,6,9,14\). The source constructions, topology, page squares and restrictions on smooth-site caps are retained. K68--69 supply the exact corrected transfer. The following earlier assertion and its argument are retained as the located historical claim; their corrected current consequences are proved in K68--69.\medskip\par For the following ten source profiles, let \(G\) be the marked primitive Mordell--Weil generator, put \(d=1/h(G)\), and choose \(M=\mathcal O(dG-O)\), translation \(Q=G\), a simple whole-fibre zero at an \(I_1\), and one order-one logarithmic gluing with gamma coefficient \(+1\) at a smooth source fibre. Use the standard vertical-edge unimodular cusp fan. These are compact complex threefolds diffeomorphic to \(S^6\). Their positive scalar-parameter loops have the indicated Jin integer and oriented \(\Theta_7\) class. \begin{center}\small\begin{tabular}{c p{0.48\textwidth} c c c}\hline OS row & Source profile & d & Jin integer A & Class mod28 \\ \hline 45 & \(I_8+4I_1\), \(I_8+II+2I_1\) & 8 & \(-3\) & 25 \\ 47 & \(I_7+I_2+3I_1\), \(I_7+I_2+II+I_1\), \(I_7+III+2I_1\) & 14 & \(-6\) & 22 \\ 55 & \(I_5+I_4+3I_1\), \(I_5+I_4+II+I_1\) & 20 & \(-9\) & 19 \\ 56 & \(I_5+I_3+I_2+2I_1\), \(I_5+I_3+III+I_1\), \(I_5+IV+I_2+I_1\) & 30 & \(-14\) & 14 \\ \hline\end{tabular}\end{center} The compact page is the indicated rational elliptic surface itself. Its line is \(M\), with square \(-d\), and \((dG)\cdot O=(d-2)/2\). Every displayed mapping torus is therefore not diffeomorphic to \(S^1\times S^6\), by the same oriented mapping-torus detection used in P3K.10 and P3F.25. There is also a restriction on additional smooth-site caps for these primitive sources. After the actual finite-kernel cancellation of P3K.19, let their primitive cap data be \((m_i,n_i,\lambda_{ai},\lambda_{bi})\), with \(\gcd(m_i,n_i)=1\). The exact orbit Mayer--Vietoris computation below gives, whenever its first-homology gluing matrix is unimodular, \[ H_2(Y;\mathbb Z)=\bigoplus_i(\mathbb Z/m_i)^2. \tag{P3K.22.1} \] Consequently a sphere member with only such smooth-site modifications has \(m_i=1\) at every site. For order-one sites the total gamma coefficient \(\sum n_i=\pm1\) gives sphere topology, including arbitrary integral source and delta collar coefficients. The individual index table above specifies the one-site positive-gamma family; it does not identify uncomputed singular-source cap choices with this family.

P3K.23.statement: \par\noindent\textbf{Physical-line correction, 17 November 2026.} The physical fixed-edge formula is \(7A_M\), where \(A_M\) is the actual physical integer. The old \(-5A\) formula is refuted. All displayed quaternion, common-link, relative-group and oriented commutator maps are retained. The native right integer is \(n=6A_M=-6A_U\); K68--69 prove the line and gluing dictionary and the corrected examples. The following earlier assertion and its argument are retained as the located historical claim; their corrected current consequences are proved in K68--69.\medskip\par Consider one of the actual sphere families constructed above with a semifree fixed curve \(F\simeq\mathbb P^1\), whose complex normal bundle is \(\mathcal O(-1)\oplus\mathcal O(-1)\). Perform the toric flop of this fixed edge in the periodic cusp model, retaining the actual parameter clutch and all exterior gluings. Write the original positive return's Jin index as \[ A=\frac{4k-\ell}{24}, \] The positive return of the flopped family has oriented class \[ -5A\pmod {28} \tag{K23.1} \] in the run's normalization of \(\Theta _7\). The flopped curve has two isolated circle fixed points. Formula (K23.1) specifies its homotopy sphere class; it does not assign a new Jin integer to that circle action. In particular, the four groups of primitive-source examples in P3K.22 give the following flopped classes: \begin{center}\small\begin{tabular}{c l l}\hline \(d=1/h(G)\) & Original index \(A\) & Flopped class in \(\mathbb Z/28\) \\ \hline \(8\) & \(-3\) & \(15\) \\ \(14\) & \(-6\) & \(2\) \\ \(20\) & \(-9\) & \(17\) \\ \(30\) & \(-14\) & \(14\) \\ \hline\end{tabular}\end{center} The earlier degree-four OS47 example of index \(-4\) gives class \(20\). Every original zero-index example remains class zero after this fixed-edge flop. No formula for a flop at another toric edge is asserted here.

P3K.24.statement: \par\noindent\textbf{Physical-line correction, 17 November 2026.} The old nonzero physical signs are refuted. The actual positive return is \(3l+2\), with Eells--Kuiper invariant \((3l+2)/28\). The two source families and their actual endpoint maps are retained. K68--69 prove this correction through the physical line. The following earlier assertion and its argument are retained as the located historical claim; their corrected current consequences are proved in K68--69.\medskip\par For the family of P3F.37, put $m=4l+3$, $l\ge0$, and retain its actual parameter $\lambda=r^m$. Its positive $r$-return satisfies \[ A(\Phi)=-(3l+2),\qquad \mu(\Sigma_\Phi)=-\frac{3l+2}{28}\pmod{\mathbb Z}, \qquad [\Phi]=26-3l\pmod{28}. \tag{K24.1} \] The same construction and formula hold for the explicit source $y^2=x^3+tx-t$, $G=(1,1)$, with fibres III*$+$II$+I_1$, using its $I_1$ as the sole simple whole-fibre zero. As $l$ runs from zero to twenty-seven, either set of families realizes all oriented classes in $\Theta_7$. For a nonzero residue its mapping torus is not diffeomorphic to $S^1\times S^6$.

P3K.25.statement: \par\noindent\textbf{Audit correction, 17 November 2026.} The asserted all-shear equality is false. In the explicitly constructed primitive OS45 family of P3K.10/P3K.22, the actual scalar loop has J=1 and reference physical class 3 by K68--69. P3K.64 gives class 2 on \(T_2\), whose directions are \(e_2\),(1,2),(1,1). The direct initial/reflected C2 equality remains the narrow comparison proved in P3K.62. The outer C1 determinant has the previously omitted winding -2J. The earlier statement and argument below are preserved as the located prior claim. \medskip For each of the ten scalar-parameter families of P3K.22, retain its actual period group, cap gluing, physical delta circle, and positive scalar-parameter loop. Replace the vertical-edge cusp fan with edge directions \[ e_2,\quad e_1,\quad e_1-e_2 \] by any of the fans with edge directions \[ e_2,\quad e_1-j e_2,\quad e_1-(j+1)e_2,\qquad j\in\mathbb Z. \tag{P3K.25.1} \] These are the actual periodic small resolutions of the same height-one model with the original period group. Their return indices and oriented return classes are equal to those in P3K.22: the values are respectively \(-3,-6,-9,-14\), and their residues are \(25,22,19,14\), in the profile groups displayed there. The conclusion includes the OS45 construction of P3K.10. The present proof uses the actual nonfixed-edge Cox bordism and charged caps of P3K.17. It does not identify the repaired local source page with the old graph trace or discard its additional line class.

P3K.27.statement: \par\noindent\textbf{Physical-line correction, 17 November 2026.} The displayed central coordinate is refuted. The characteristic pair \((-3d,-24)\) is the meridian-one dual-line pair; the actual free integers remain \((6,3d-6)\), while the physical central class is \(d/2-1\). The actual Cox framing comparison is retained. K68--69 provide the precise convention map. The following earlier assertion and its argument are retained as the located historical claim; their corrected current consequences are proved in K68--69.\medskip\par For the ten primitive scalar families of K22, use the actual positive scalar loop, the standard vertical-edge cusp, and the normal product transported by the extending cusp origin. Its free normal-framing gauge agrees with the transported rotating framing of K9. A possible constant rotation loop extends over the fixed three-disc and changes neither integer. Thus the rotating characteristic pair and the corresponding relative coordinates may be taken to be \[ k=-3d,\qquad \ell=-24,\qquad (m_{\rm rel},n_{\rm rel},s) =(6,\ 3d-6,\ 1-d/2\bmod28). \tag{P3K.27.1} \] Here \(d=8,14,20,30\) is the height denominator in K22. The coordinate convention is exactly K23, including its complex orientation and the positively oriented Eells--Kuiper generator. This does not identify a further edge's relative four-cycle.

P3K.29.statement: \par\noindent\textbf{Audit correction, 17 November 2026.} The claimed simultaneous marked delta-equivariant plumbing product does not exist for nonzero scalar winding J: P3K.61 derives the incompatible determinant equation -J=0. In the actual native C1 product, P3K.62 gives the single free pair (J,-J), contradicting the stated zero right coefficient at J=1. The integral cells, common-exterior bases, dual maps, symmetry and exact local frame-change identity remain valid in their displayed markings. The earlier statement and argument below are preserved as the located prior claim. \medskip For the actual index-one cusp with its three complex double curves, use positive complex normal meridians \(m_i\) and the relative dual basis \(m_j\cdot D_i=\delta_{ji}\). The literal common-exterior map under the flop of \(C_0\) is \[ m'_0=-m_0+2m_1+2m_2,\quad m'_1=m_1,\quad m'_2=m_2, \qquad D'_0=-D_0,\quad D'_j=D_j+2D_0\ (j=1,2). \] For the scalar-parameter families and the extending cusp products of K22--27, in a fan retaining the physical delta edge the actual relative return has variation \(\operatorname{diag}(v,0,0)\), where \(v=k_{\rm Jin}\) in the stated complex-meridian dual basis. For K22--27, \(v=-3d\). After the fixed-edge flop its exact variation matrix is \[ v\begin{pmatrix}1&-2&-2\\-2&4&4\\-2&4&4\end{pmatrix}. \] The two original nonfixed curves have integer relative derivative coefficient \(n_{\rm rel}=0\) in K23's specified product framing. No relative Pontryagin coefficient after the fixed-edge flop is assigned by this statement.

P3K.30.statement: \par\noindent\textbf{Physical-line correction, 17 November 2026.} The displayed central coordinate is refuted. With \(U=M^{-1}\), the retained pair is \((k_U,\ell_U)=(-3H,-24\chi)\), the physical pair is \((3H,24\chi)\), and the physical central class is \(H/2-\chi\). The native free pair \((6\chi,3H-6\chi)\) is retained. K68--69 prove the exact line and transfer maps. The following earlier assertion and its argument are retained as the located historical claim; their corrected current consequences are proved in K68--69.\medskip\par For every actual page of P3K.26 and P3K.28, let \(M\) be its page-cover degree, \(h(G)=1/d\), and \(aG\) its marked line point. Write \(H=Ma^2/d\) and \(\chi=\chi(\mathcal O_{S_{\rm page}})\). Use the actual vertical-edge Cox normal product transported by the extending signed cusp origin. For one positive loop in the actual parameter \(r\), with \(\lambda=r^M\), the individual Jin pair and the K23 relative coordinates are \[ \begin{aligned} k&=-3H,&\ell&=-24\chi,\\ m_{\rm rel}&=6\chi,&n_{\rm rel}&=3H-6\chi,\\ s&=\chi-H/2\pmod{28}. \end{aligned} \] This holds for both one-cap norms \(n=\pm1\) and both joint determinants \(D=\pm1\). The comparison fixes the actual initial Cox quaternion frame; a possible extending constant rotation loop changes neither integer. No different fan edge's relative four-cycle is assigned here.

P3K.31.statement: \par\noindent\textbf{Audit correction, 17 November 2026.} The universal fan polynomial is false. The primitive OS45 family of P3K.10/P3K.22 has reference physical class 3 and scalar winding J=1, by K68--69. On the actual \(T_2\) fan, delta has coordinates (0,1), so the old norm polynomial assigns equal values to T0 and T2; P3K.64 constructs the full maps and proves a difference of -1. K68--69 give the corrected absolute classes 3 and 2. The single-star product-frame, boundary flop and complex normal reset maps are retained; the scalar initial data and universal formula are withdrawn. The earlier statement and argument below are preserved as the located prior claim. \medskip For every actual family and positive parameter loop of P3K.27 or P3K.30, retain its physical delta cocharacter and all exterior gluings, and use any allowed index-one periodic unimodular cusp fan \(T(v,w)\). Write \[ \delta_{\rm circle}=r v+s w,\qquad S=r^2-rs+s^2,\qquad \gcd(r,s)=1. \] Let \(k,\ell,A=(4k-\ell)/24\) be the initial vertical-edge integers in the actual Cox framing of those statements. The oriented return class for the specified fan is \[ [\Sigma_{\Phi,T}] =A+\frac{\ell}{8}(S-1)-\frac{k}{8}(S^2-1) \pmod{28}. \tag{P3K.31.0} \] The expression is integral. It is computed by the actual common exterior, stable tangent-frame change, and complex normal reset through every periodic flop. For K27 this becomes \[ 4-3S+\frac d8(3S^2-7)\pmod{28}, \qquad d=8,14,20,30. \] For K30, with its proved \(H=Ma^2/d\) and page Euler characteristic \(\chi\), it becomes \[ \chi(4-3S)+\frac H8(3S^2-7)\pmod{28}. \] The exact finite ranges for K27 are given in the proof. The original construction's single \(w\)-loop is treated separately in P3K.33 by its explicit simultaneous endpoint descent. No cover class is divided.

P3K.32.statement: \par\noindent\textbf{Physical-line correction, 17 November 2026.} The displayed physical central coordinate is refuted and the broad all-fan final sentence remains withdrawn. The topology, signed norm reduction and page data are retained. Its reference physical integer is \(H/2-\chi\); its retained dual-line characteristic and free-relative data have the convention stated in K69. The actual vertical-fan corrections are K64 and K67. The following earlier assertion and its argument are retained as the located historical claim; their corrected current consequences are proved in K68--69.\medskip\par Consider the actual source and root-cap data of P3F.36, P3F.38, P3F.41--43, P3F.46--47, and the primitive-source data of P3K.22. Retain any finite collection of fixed order-one elliptic, gamma, and delta clutches at additional smooth or multiplicative source values, including their annular units and finite line characters. Put the surviving core values at $\infty,0$; a missing core is an ordinary disc of order one and norm zero. Write their orders and signed norms as $(m_\infty,n_\infty),(m_0,n_0)$, the added signed norms as $n_j$, and the retained base relation as $\sum\alpha_i+b_0\gamma=0$. Define \[ N=\sum_jn_j-b_0,\qquad n_\infty'=n_\infty+m_\infty N,\qquad D=m_0n_\infty'+m_\infty n_0. \tag{K32.1} \] The sphere locus is exactly $D=\pm1$. This topology conclusion holds for every allowed cusp fan. On that locus put $M=m_\infty m_0$, and use the actual parameter $\lambda=r^M$. The vertical-edge reference member has corrected compact page line $N_{\rm page}$, with \[ H=-c_1(N_{\rm page})^2=\frac{Ma^2}{d},\qquad \chi=\chi(\mathcal O_{S_{\rm page}}),\qquad h(G)=1/d. \] Its full characteristic and relative data are \[ \begin{aligned} k&=-3H,&\ell&=-24\chi,& A^{\rm Jin}&=\chi-H/2,\\ m_{\rm rel}&=6\chi,&n_{\rm rel}&=3H-6\chi, &s&=A^{\rm Jin}\pmod {28}. \end{aligned}\tag{K32.2} \] Thus the single- and joint-cap tables of P3K.26 and P3K.28 apply with the actual norm $n_\infty'$ and all their root-order restrictions retained. In the primitive sector without a distinguished additive cap, the page is the original rational elliptic source and \[ (k,\ell)=(-3d,-24),\qquad (m_{\rm rel},n_{\rm rel})=(6,3d-6),\qquad A^{\rm Jin}=1-d/2. \tag{K32.3} \] The return data in these formulas use the reference fan; the actual flop maps transport its relative coordinates to the returns for the other allowed fans.

P3K.33.statement: \par\noindent\textbf{Proved counterexample, 17 November 2026.} The actual original K=L=1 shorter loop on \(T_2\) has physical class 26; the displayed S=1 polynomial gives 0. P3K.74 gives the actual data and proof. P3K.73 supplies the corrected complete scalar-fan algorithm in the whole-zero I1 scope. The earlier assertion and argument below are preserved as the false compound claim; their explicitly retained construction and comparison maps are identified in P3K.74. \par\noindent\textbf{Audit correction, 17 November 2026.} The explicit parameter/root/cap descent and individual reference fixed-star comparison are retained. The all-fan application of P3K.31 and its numerical range are withdrawn; a simultaneous equivariant product of the full marked plumbing cannot be supplied merely by the fixed-star product. The formulas and earlier argument below are retained as the audited prior claim, not as current proved conclusions. See P3K.61--62 and the correction ledger. \medskip Retain the actual K11 construction with logarithmic orders \(3K,4L\), \(\gcd(3K,4L)=1\), and either sphere datum \[ 4Ln_0+3Kn_1=\varepsilon,\qquad \varepsilon\in\{1,-1\}. \] The additional delta coefficients of the finite logarithmic vectors may be arbitrary among the already admissible data; they are fixed by the parameter shear and do not enter the calculation below. Put \[ P=4Ln_0,\qquad Q=3Kn_1,\qquad b=2KL,\qquad d=12KL. \] The actual closed parameter is \[ w_h=e^{-\pi i c/(KL)},\qquad u=\kappa w_h^{2KL}, \qquad w_h=r^6,\qquad v=\frac{\log r}{2\pi i}. \] Thus a positive \(w_h\)-loop sends \(c\) to \(c-b\) and \(v\) to \(v+1/6\). There is an explicit extending endpoint translation and an actual simultaneously closed Cox product on all three cusp curves and both triple points for this single loop. In that product the fixed-edge normal integers are \[ (k,\ell)=(-KL,-4KL),\qquad (m_{\rm rel},n_{\rm rel},s)=(KL,0,0). \] For every allowed index-one unimodular periodic fan \(T(v_1,v_2)\), write the fixed physical circle as \(a v_1+b_1v_2\), with \(\gcd(a,b_1)=1\), and set \[ S=a^2-ab_1+b_1^2. \] The actual positive single-loop return has oriented class \[ [\Sigma_{\Phi,T}] =KL\frac{(S-1)(S-3)}8\pmod {28}. \tag{P3K.33.1} \] For the original \(K=L=1\) family the exact set of classes is \[ \{0,1,3,6,7,8,10,13,14,15,17,20,21,22,24,27\}. \] The same values apply to both determinant signs, by the actual signed page and Thom maps below. No homotopy-sphere class is divided in the proof.

P3K.34.statement: \par\noindent\textbf{Audit correction, 17 November 2026.} The universal OS49 fan formula below is false. For \(k=1\), the original negative-diagonal fan has \(S=1\) in its primitive \(H/K\) marking, so that formula gives \(0\); P3K.65 proves the actual positive \(r\)-loop class \(-3\). Its shorter negative-fan class is \(-k\), while the positive-fan class is \(0\). The old statement below is retained as the refuted record. The proof following it is the corrected local page and framing calculation, with physical pair \((2m,8m)\), and does not prove the old signs or the old all-fan formula. The original argument is preserved in \path{records/attempts/post19_recovery/oc_checkpoint19/notes/part3_os49_full_framing.tex}. The current vertical and all-fan formulas are P3K.76 and P3K.77. \medskip Retain the actual component-supported OS49 families of P3F.31--32, with \(\lambda=r^{3k}\), \(k>0\), and cap vector \(n(1,-1,0,0)^t+d\delta\), where \(n=\pm1\) and \(d\in\mathbb Z\). For one positive physical \(r\)-loop, in the initial positive-diagonal Cox product the individual integers and relative coordinates are \[ k_{\rm Jin}=-6k,\qquad \ell_{\rm Jin}=-24k,\qquad (m_{\rm rel},n_{\rm rel},s)=(6k,0,0). \tag{OC.1} \] The pair is the same for both norm signs. The line used has its actual \(I_2\) multidegree \((-1,+1)\) and relative square \(-2k\). For every actual allowed index-one fan \(T(v,w)\), write the physical delta cocharacter as \(\delta=a v+b w\), and set \(S=a^2-ab+b^2\). Its oriented return class is \[ [\Sigma_{\Phi,T}]=\frac{3k}{4}(S-1)(S-3)\pmod{28}. \tag{OC.2} \] At fixed \(k\), its exact range is \(k\{0,4,6,8,14,18,20,22\}\pmod{28}\). These conclusions retain the component line, both signed norm maps, the simultaneous closed Cox product, and the actual common-exterior frame comparison. They use the stated physical parameter loop.

P3F.53.statement: \par\noindent\textbf{Proved counterexample, 17 November 2026.} The fully specified primitive OS45 reference loop has physical class 3; the displayed reference value is-3=25. P3K.74 gives the actual data and proof. P3K.73 supplies the corrected complete scalar-fan algorithm in the whole-zero I1 scope. The earlier assertion and argument below are preserved as the false compound claim; their explicitly retained construction and comparison maps are identified in P3K.74. \par\noindent\textbf{Audit correction, 17 November 2026.} The source-pair and root tables, cap topology, exact endpoint constructions and independent reference page/line values are retained. The all-fan polynomial fields and ranges import P3K.31 and are withdrawn pending a corrected actual scalar product computation. The formulas and earlier argument below are retained as the audited prior claim, not as current proved conclusions. See P3K.61--62 and the correction ledger. \medskip The fixed-source canonical scalar sphere families in the literal whole-fibre construction of E26 Remark~8.5, with rational elliptic source and Mordell--Weil group \(\mathbb Z\), are exactly the sixteen profiles and twenty-six source pairs in the two tables below. Their root table has thirty-one branches; the good/good \(III^*+II\) branch has no sphere solution, and the other thirty have precisely the displayed coprimality and determinant conditions. All fixed source coefficients, allowed vertical source lines, primitive effective cap actions and order-one clutches are included through the comparison maps in the proof. For the actual canonical scalar parameter \(\lambda=r^M\), put \[ M=m_\infty m_0,\qquad H=Ma^2/d,\qquad \chi=\frac{M(12-e_\infty-e_0)+m_0e'_\infty+m_\infty e'_0}{12}. \] The specified complex page, source section and relative line have height \(H\), relative square \(-H\), and tangent number \(-24\chi\). Both determinant signs give the reference characteristic pair \((-3H,-24\chi)\) and return index \(A=\chi-H/2\). On the actual fan \(T(v_1,v_2)\), with \(\delta=pv_1+qv_2\) and \(S=p^2-pq+q^2\), the class is \[ [\Sigma_{\Phi,T}] =\chi(4-3S)+H(3S^2-7)/8\quad\hbox{in }\mathbb Z/28. \] The actual shorter original loop, component-supported OS49 loop, and general weighted shorter scalar loop are accounted for through K33--35 and their explicit endpoint maps.
